title: erodium romanum var. carvifolium
intro: Erodium romanum var. carvifolium, commonly known as the Corn Marigold or Corn Rose, is a plant species in the geranium family (Geraniaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a useful remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Erodium romanum var. carvifolium are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
